name: Evil toymaker
description: A toymaker who bought the doll from bandits and was arrested by villagers after his stuffed-bear minion was incinerated.

timeline.summary: The doll is kidnapped by bandits and sold to an evil toymaker, whose stuffed-bear minion dies in battle with villagers, leaving the doll on the street.
timeline.quote: I was kidnapped by bandits and sold to an evil toymaker.
